blocks.text: I really enjoyed the article, “A Child’s First Fast” in the Summer 2012 issue of Halal Consumer. As a mother of a 9-year-old, and 8-year-old and a 7-year-old, I am sure the advice and tips will come in very handy in the near future.
got my copy of Halal Consumer yesterday….great job!!!
I hope I’ll get mine soon. Can’t wait… Love this page.
Me and my sister made the date filled cookies recipe and we shared some with the community at Iftar at our local masjid. Everyone loved it and asked where we got the recipe.
I love Halal Consumer, especially it’s recipes.
